subject: general
question: Which of the following states has the National Academy of Sciences?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **National Academy of Sciences:-**

 
 
• **The National Academy of Sciences (India) is located in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The National Academy of Sciences is a premier scientific organization in India, established in 1930.
 
• It is an autonomous institution that aims to promote science and its application for the benefit of society.
 
• The academy comprises distinguished scientists and engineers from various fields of science and technology.
